scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @spheric/api" "npm run dev -w @spheric/worker" "npm run dev -w @spheric/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spheric/shared && npm run build -w @spheric/db && npm run build -w @spheric/connectors && npm run build -w @spheric/agents && npm run build -w @spheric/api && npm run build -w @spheric/worker && npm run build -w @spheric/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spheric/shared -w @spheric/db -w @spheric/connectors -w @spheric/agents && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
